summary: @aleciamarie #lra18 I found this very hard to negotiate when studying eight years of data from #IndieWeb community. It is all archived, and uses strict metadata formats making analysis easy, but there are people and histories and their futures to consider.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @aleciamarie #lra18 I found this very hard to negotiate when studying eight years of data from #IndieWeb community. It is all archived, and uses strict metadata formats making analysis easy, but there are people and histories and their futures to consider.
